Dispute Reason: fraudulent

Jessica Lee (CUST-002) is an established repeat customer with 5 prior orders and $1,120 lifetime value. On August 25, 2026, Ms. Lee authorized a $340.00 charge for a ceramic pour-over set. The transaction passed all security verification: CVC matched, AVS postal code matched, and MasterCard approved. Ms. Lee requested an address change to 880 Harrison St, San Francisco, CA 94107 on the same day, demonstrating full knowledge and ownership of the order. The order was fulfilled and delivered on September 5, 2026. Recommendation: Concede dispute based on merchant policy for repeat customers under vip_concede_max_cents threshold ($500.00) to protect customer lifetime value ($1,120) and preserve customer relationship.
